sentences.text: Kulwinder Singh

... Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Punjab And Another
 ... Respondents
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice H.S. Grewal.
Present: Mr. S.S. Behl, Senior Advocate with Mr. Jugraj Sigh Chouhan and
Mr. Sagar Bansal, Advocates for the petitioner.
Mr. P.S. Pandher, Aag, Punjab.

* * **
H.S. Grewal, J. (Oral)

The petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking quashing of FIR No.187 dated 27.11.2024 under Sections 420, 380 and 120-B of IPC registered at Police Station Tibba, District Ludhiana as well as the challan dated 28.07.2025.
2.
Mr. Ajit Singh, Advocate has appeared and filed power of attorney on behalf of respondent No.2.

Same is taken on record.
2.
Earlier, the petitioner had filed a petition bearing No.25062 of 2025 seeking quashing of the abovementioned FIR.

On 08.05.2025, a Co- ordinate Bench of this Court had disposed of the said petition while issuing the following directions: -
"6.

Keeping in view the aforesaid facts and circumstances, present petition is disposed of with a direction to the Investigating Officer to consider all the documents, which are annexed with the present petition and averments made in the present petition, before preparing the final report under Section 193 of BNSS, 2023 (erstwhile Section 173 Cr.P.C.)
7.

It is clarified that in case, final report under Section 193 of BNSS, 2023 (erstwhile Section 173 Cr.P.C.) is against the petitioners, they would be at liberty to file a fresh petition to challenge the FIR (supra) as well as the final report under Section 193 of BNSS, 2023 (erstwhile Section 173 Cr.P.C.)."
1 of 2

3. Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner contends that the Investigating Officer has prepared the challan against the petitioner and has filed the final report before the trial Court without complying Kulwinder Singh vs State Of Punjab And Another on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164043517/
1 with the order dated 08.05.2025 (Annexure P-10) and the document (Annexure P-12).
4.

entities.text: Kulwinder Singh vs State Of Punjab And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Investigating Officer Amrik Singh is present in Court and contends that he had handed over the further investigation to ASI Surjan Singh, who completed the same and thereafter, the challan was presented by the SI/SHO Jaspal Singh.
5. It seems that the SHO has filed the challan without complying with the order dated 08.05.2025 (Annexure P-10) and the document (Annexure P- 12).

Accordingly, the Investigating Officer is hereby directed to move an appropriate application before the trial Court, seeks necessary orders and file a supplementary challan taking into consideration the order dated 08.05.2025 (Annexure P-10) and the document (Annexure P-12).
6.
Petitions stands disposed of accordingly.
7. In case any grievance of the petitioner still survives, he may approach this Court by way of filing fresh petition.
(H.S. GREWAL)
FEBRUARY 04, 2026.
JUDGE Rajender
